title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：organisation　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 organisation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the clerk ① joined the organisation that no applicant in the office would have noted, and he said the joining was the whole of the month. The ② organisation, meaning the group itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; an organisation, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ organisation in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ organisation at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An organisation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the clerk said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the organisation was the whole of the matter, meaning the order and not the group. The ⑥ organisation, meaning the order and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; organisation, he said, is either something you join or the only word that means both a group and an order. He said the order is the part they remember.

By 1991 the ⑦ organisation had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ organisation of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of noting; organisation, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ organisation I remember is the group noted in the file, which closed in 1993 and is still noted as the quietest in the office. An ⑩ organisation, my mother said in 1995, is the only group that improves by being noted; every organisation, she said, is an order that has agreed to look like a group. She said the order was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 组织；机构（指办事处里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 组织；机构（指那个组织本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：join the organisation 加入这一个组织
D. n. 组织；机构（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 组织之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的组织之事）
F. n. 组织；机构（指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 组织、秩序（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 秩序（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: joined the organisation that no applicant in the office would have noted
The organisation, meaning the group itself and not the stamp
the organisation at the far counter

answers.why: join the organisation 意为“加入这一个组织”，1986 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记下的一个组织做了一遍。
organisation 意为“组织；机构”，指那个组织本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
organisation 意为“组织；机构”，指办事处里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
organisation 意为“组织；机构”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
organisation 意为“组织、秩序”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个秩序就是那件事的全部。
organisation 意为“秩序”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个组织，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
organisation 意为“组织；机构”，指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1991 年这一个成了卷宗里的一行。
organisation 意为“组织之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的组织之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记下。
organisation 意为“组织；机构”，我记得的是卷宗里记下过的那一个，1993 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一个。
organisation 为抽象总称，母亲 1995 年说，组织是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的组织。
